### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (very strong — review venue)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must be **integrative reviews or meta-analyses** advancing educational psychology theory. Empirical original research outside scope.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Empirical work redirected to J Edu Psych or Contemporary Edu Psych.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Original empirical work (consider J Edu Psych, Contemporary Edu Psych)
- Literature compilations without theoretical synthesis
- AI use without disclosure per Springer policy

### Soft Tax

Moderate. Integrative-review writing demands extensive engagement with multiple educational-psychology subfield literatures.

### Best Suited For

- Integrative educational-psychology theoretical reviews
- Cognitive load theory and instructional design synthesis
- Self-regulated learning and motivation reviews
- Meta-analyses of educational interventions
- Learning sciences cross-disciplinary integration

### Not Recommended For

- Original empirical educational research
- Pure qualitative work
- Authors unfamiliar with educational-psychology review tradition

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Educational Psychology](./journal-of-educational-psychology.md) | If reframed as empirical-test; APA family |
| 2 | [Contemporary Educational Psychology](./contemporary-educational-psychology.md) | Elsevier peer for educational psychology |
| 3 | [Review of General Psychology](./review-of-general-psychology.md) | If broader integrative-psychology scope; APA Division 1 |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from J Edu Psych as "needs more theoretical synthesis," Educational Psychology Review is the natural Springer integrative-review home.
